release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.3

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Rotate: A Rotate Pages step after Mail Merge keeps the photos in the built PDF. The preview and the build show the same turned page.

Bleed: The side strips of a grown bleed stay the page image in a PDF viewer and on a RIP. They are no longer black in the viewer and white on the press.

Booklet: On a sheet larger than the pair, such as A5 pages on SRA4, each page keeps its own size. The pair scales down only when it does not fit the sheet.

Multi-up: With Autoscale on, crop marks sit on the page trim. They no longer sit on the outer edge of the bleed.

Mail merge: Clear Recipe clears the mail-merge fields, so the next build does not reuse the previous spreadsheet. Moving through a recipe that includes Mail Merge no longer freezes the window. The preview still uses 40 data rows. Export still uses every row.

Bleed step: Clicking Grow Bleed in the recipe opens the Bleed window with the saved settings. It does not open Multi-up, and Multi-up settings are not applied to that preview.
